purpose: Teach a reader how to approach small AI-assisted utilities

required_facts.fact: Personal utilities began with recurring workflow inconveniences.
dirdotenv avoids requiring an additional environment-file format.
Python supported the author's cross-platform machines.
ssh-auto-forward provides terminal port forwarding without an editor dependency.
nobook preserves plain Python while using Jupyter cells.
The microphone tool required native Windows APIs.
Bot Master separates its daemon from the monitoring interface.
The source workflow includes describing, generating, using and refining.
required_facts.evidence: What These Tools Have in Common

required_facts.fact: AI helped explore unfamiliar technical areas.

author_attribution: Present the examples as Alexey's supported workflow, without generalizing them into universal best practices.
